title: check-adr-0087-registration: a `type X = {` alias that follows a semicolon-less statement reads its body as a value, so its annotated members read as erased
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxRDKprCtjpEdtiPFW

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding of the #38144 dev (os-dev report, #38144 comment 7235496909). Source: seat repo:objectstack#1 area `o1-F`. ⛔ Not a claim.
Grading (suggested, triage's call): area:fleet · Bug · reach: ADR-0087 predicate 4 readings of a member of a type-literal alias in any file whose preceding statement ends without a semicolon · evidence: measured at origin/main `9dca1097bd` and at PR #38179 head `9e13d6d24a`.
Dedupe: `braceOpensTypeBody`, `semicolon-less alias`, `sitsInTypePosition` → only #38144 open, a different mechanism (a type literal inside a header, not where the header starts).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：发版检查里读类型的工具，遇到 `type X = { ... }` 这种写法时，如果它前一行语句没写分号，就会把这个类型的成员当成「没有标注」。和 #38144 同一个方向：本该拦下的改动可能被放行。
- 修法：让它在没有分号的语句之后也能认出类型别名的开头，并补上能证明修好的测试。
- 要你做的：无。

## Measured

- `readTypeSurfaceRef` answers "`SidebarContextProps.setOpen`, which carries NO return annotation" (erased) for `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx#SidebarContextProps.setOpen`; `setOpenMobile` and `toggleSidebar` read the same. Same reading at origin/main `9dca1097bd` and at `9e13d6d24a`.
- Cause: `braceOpensTypeBody` recognises a type alias only at the start of the header it collects. After a semicolon-less statement the header starts at that earlier statement (here `from "./tooltip" const SIDEBAR_... =`), so the alias body reads as a value.
- Minimal repro: `import { a } from "b"\n\ntype T = {\n  f: () => void\n}\n` gives `memberReturnAnnotation` f = null; the same text with `export interface T {` gives `void`.
- Direction: permissive for predicate 4 (an annotated member reads as erased).

## Acceptance

- A member of a `type X = {` alias reads its annotation when the alias follows a semicolon-less statement; the sidebar instance above resolves to its annotation.
- Pins: the minimal repro, the real sidebar shape, and a lit control (the same alias after a `;`); an ablation reds them. The #38093, #38137 and #38144 pins stay green.

Surface: `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (`braceOpensTypeBody`). Serial after PR #38179 (#38144, same function).
Blocked-by: #38144
